items.title: Section: A Life That Only Ever Decreases, and the Faculties Named by Lay Life Versus Monastic Life

items.zh: 顯了有情增長增上義故，建立二根。顯了有情壽漸損減增上義故，建立一根。顯了有情興盛、衰損增上義故，建立五根。顯了有情功德、過失增上義故，建立八根。復次，依如是名，建立六根。依如是種、如是姓，建立二根。依如是食、如是受苦樂，建立五根。依如是長壽、如是久住、如是壽量邊際，建立一根。當知此諸根，依在家品施設建立。依如是信、如是精進，乃至如是慧、如是向、如是果，建立八根。當知此諸根，依出家品施設建立。
items.en: Because of the dominant significance of revealing a being's increase, two faculties are established. Because of the dominant significance of revealing a being's lifespan gradually diminishing, one faculty is established. Next, according to such names, six faculties are established. According to such lineage and such family name, two faculties are established. According to such food, and such experience of pleasure and pain, five faculties are established. According to such long life, such long abiding, and such a furthest limit of lifespan, one faculty is established. It should be understood that these faculties are established according to the designations of lay life. According to such faith, such diligence, up through such wisdom, such approach, and such fruit, eight faculties are established. It should be understood that these faculties are established according to the designations of monastic life.

items.title: Section: The Sixth and Final Scheme — Guarding the Sense-Doors on the Way to a Fruit of Practice

items.zh: 復次，依修行者防護根門增上義故，建立六根。堪得出家證沙門果增上義故，建立二根。積集善品增上義故，建立一根。正知而行增上義故，建立五根。證沙門果諸方便道增上義故，建立五根。證沙門果增上義故，建立三根。
items.en: Next, because of the dominant significance of a practitioner guarding the sense-doors, six faculties are established. Because of the dominant significance of being fit to renounce household life and realise a contemplative's fruit, two faculties are established. Because of the dominant significance of accumulating wholesome qualities, one faculty is established. Because of the dominant significance of acting with clear comprehension, five faculties are established. Because of the dominant significance of the various means leading to a contemplative's fruit, five faculties are established. Because of the dominant significance of actually realising a contemplative's fruit, three faculties are established.

items.zh: 中嗢拕南曰：隨境界轉等、由顯、及內門、莊嚴、二有情、假設、防護等。

items.title: Section: A Summary Verse for Six Schemes, and What Each Faculty Actually Does

items.zh: 問：眼根作何等業？答：於諸色境已見、今見、當見為業。如是耳根乃至意根所有作業，如應當知。問：男根、女根作何等業？答：父母、妻子、親戚、眷屬互相攝受顯現為業。問：命根作何等業？答：令諸有情墮在存活住持數中為業。問：受所攝根作何等業？答：令諸有情領納一切興盛、衰損為業。問：信等諸根作何等業？答：能生善趣及能圓滿涅槃資糧為業。問：最後三根作何等業？答：能於現法趣證涅槃為業。
items.en: Question: what function does the eye faculty perform? Answer: it functions to see form already seen, now being seen, and yet to be seen. As with this, so too should the function of the remaining faculties through mind be understood. Question: what function do the male and female faculties perform? Answer: they function to draw parents, spouses, children, relatives, and extended family into mutual, visible connection. Question: what function does the life faculty perform? Answer: it functions to place beings among the category of the continuously living and sustained. Question: what function do the faculties subsumed under feeling perform? Answer: they function to let beings experience all manner of prosperity and decline. Question: what function do the faculties of faith and the rest perform? Answer: they function to generate a favourable rebirth and to bring the provisions for nirvāṇa to completion. Question: what function do the final three faculties perform? Answer: they function to bring one, in this very life, to the attainment of nirvāṇa.

items.title: Section: Sixteen Real Faculties, Six Merely Provisional, and What Category Each One Falls Under

items.zh: 問：如是諸根幾是實有，幾非實有？答：十六實有；餘非實有。問：幾色所攝？答：七。問：幾心所攝？答：一，三少分。問：幾心法所攝？答：十，三少分。問：幾心不相應行所攝？答：一。
items.en: Question: of these faculties, how many are genuinely real? How many are not genuinely real? Answer: sixteen are genuinely real; the rest are not. Question: how many are subsumed under form? Answer: seven. Question: how many are subsumed under mind? Answer: one, with three partially so. Question: how many are subsumed under mental factors? Answer: ten, with three partially so. Question: how many are subsumed under formations dissociated from mind? Answer: one.

items.title: Section: Why Sorrow Alone Among the Faculties Can Never Be Morally Neutral

items.zh: 問：幾有為所攝？答：一切是有為，無有根是無為。問：男女二根何等根分？答：是身根分。問：最後三根何等根分？答：是九根分。所謂意根，信等五根，樂、喜、捨根。問：命根何等根分？答：此無所屬。依先業所引時量決定而建立故，唯說假有。問：幾善？答：或八；或五，及六少分。問：幾不善？答：六少分。問：幾無記？答：八，五少分。
items.en: Question: how many are subsumed under the conditioned? Answer: all are conditioned; no faculty is unconditioned. Question: of which faculty are the male and female faculties a phase? Answer: they are a phase of the body faculty. Question: of which faculties are the final three faculties a phase? Answer: they are a phase of nine faculties, namely the mind faculty, the five faculties of faith and the rest, and the faculties of pleasure, joy, and equanimity. Question: of which faculty is the life faculty a phase? Answer: it belongs to none, being established purely upon a fixed duration determined by prior karma, and is said to be only provisionally existent. Question: how many are wholesome? Answer: either eight, or five together with six partially. Question: how many are unwholesome? Answer: six partially. Question: how many are neutral? Answer: eight, together with five partially.

items.title: Section: Which Faculties Ripen Into Karmic Fruit, and Which Are That Fruit Itself

items.zh: 問：幾有異熟？答：一，十少分。問：幾無異熟？答：十一，十少分。問：幾有異熟助伴？答：最後三，能助有可愛異熟法，令轉明盛，能感決定人天異熟。
items.en: Question: how many possess karmic ripening? Answer: one, together with ten partially. Question: how many lack karmic ripening? Answer: eleven, together with ten partially. Question: how many serve as a supporting companion to karmic ripening? Answer: the final three, which assist in bringing about a desirable karmic result, causing it to grow ever brighter, and definitively securing rebirth among humans or gods.

items.title: Section: Closing Karmic Ripening — Which Faculties Are the Fruit Itself, Which Merely Come From Its Seed

items.zh: 問：幾是異熟？答：一，九少分。問：幾有種子異熟？答：一切皆有。問：幾非異熟？答：十二，九少分。問：幾是異熟生？答：亦一切，種子所攝異熟所生故。
items.en: Question: how many are themselves karmic ripening? Answer: one, together with nine partially. Question: how many possess a seed of karmic ripening? Answer: all of them do. Question: how many are not karmic ripening? Answer: twelve, together with nine partially. Question: how many are generated from karmic ripening? Answer: likewise all of them, since all are subsumed under seeds and generated from ripening.

items.title: Section: Which Faculties Belong to Which Realm, and Which Belong to None at All

items.zh: 問：幾欲界繫？答：四，十五少分。問：幾色界繫？答：十五少分。問：幾無色界繫？答：八少分。問：幾不繫？答：三，九少分。
items.en: Question: how many are confined to the desire realm? Answer: four, together with fifteen partially. Question: how many are confined to the form realm? Answer: fifteen partially. Question: how many are confined to the formless realm? Answer: eight partially. Question: how many are confined to no realm at all? Answer: three, together with nine partially.

items.zh: 問：未至地幾可得？答：十一。問：若未至地有喜根者，何故不如初靜慮地建立喜耶？答：由於彼地喜可動故。問：喜於彼有何教為證？答：如世尊言：如是苾芻！離生喜樂滋潤其身，周遍滋潤、遍流、遍悅，無有少分不充不滿，如是名為離生喜樂。此中初門說未至位，後門說根本位。問：初靜慮地幾根可得？答：十八。

blocks.text: How each faculty functions, which are real and which provisional, and which belong to which realm.
Master Cháng Bǎi: other things may rise and fall, but a being's life only decreases from birth.
The eye sees form already seen, now seen, and to be seen. The last three faculties bring one to nirvāṇa in this very life.
Sixteen are real, the rest not. Master Cháng Bǎi: male and female faculties are phases of the body faculty; the life faculty is a dissociated formation.
Eight are neutral, five partly. Master Cháng Bǎi: all ripened results are neutral.

Master Cháng Bǎi: "having ripening" means able to bring a future ripened result; "being ripening" means being such a result. The last three help desirable ripening, securing rebirth among humans and gods.
Master Cháng Bǎi: desire-realm beings have male and female faculties, and mostly sorrow and pain.
"Life only decreases from birth." A plain fact, stated without drama. The treatise lets it stand.

quiz.q: Why does the life faculty show a lifespan diminishing, and how do feelings relate to flourishing and decline?
options: the life faculty grows with practice, granting long life; sorrow at flourishing and joy at decline
it neither grows nor shrinks, life being fixed
feeling has no relation to flourishing or decline
other things rise and fall, but the life faculty only decreases from birth; joy and pleasure at flourishing, sorrow and pain at decline, equanimity at both
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: other phenomena may rise and fall, but a being's life faculty only decreases from birth. When beings flourish, joy and pleasure are active; in decline, sorrow and pain; equanimity extends to both. This fits the treatise's phrase that the life faculty reveals a gradually diminishing lifespan.

quiz.q: What is the function of the eye faculty?
options: seeing form already seen, now being seen, and yet to be seen
seeing form only now, not past or future, the eye taking only the present, so the treatise omits the others
hearing sound past, present, and future
discriminating mental objects
quiz.why: The treatise says the eye functions to see form already seen, now seen, and to be seen. Master Cháng Bǎi: this is in terms of the range of the eye faculty's function: the past eye sees past form, and the future eye future form. It does not mean a present eye sees the past.

quiz.q: What is the function of the final three faculties, and how does Master Cháng Bǎi divide them?
options: to generate favourable rebirth and complete provisions; all three are identical, causes of human and heavenly results
to place beings among the living
to let beings experience flourishing and decline
to go towards and realise nirvāṇa in this life; the first two partly realise and go towards, the third completes it
quiz.why: The treatise says they function to bring one in this very life to nirvāṇa. Master Cháng Bǎi: of the three uncontaminated faculties, the first two enable beings to partly realise nirvāṇa and go towards complete realisation. So 趣 and 證 are both meant, which the English "attainment" alone does not convey.

quiz.q: How many of the twenty-two are real, and why are male, female, and life faculties provisional?
options: nineteen real; male and female are real, only the three being provisional, the path being unobtainable
all twenty-two are provisional, all being empty, "sixteen" being a manner of speaking
all twenty-two are real
sixteen real; male and female are phases of the body faculty, and life a phase of the duration karma brings
quiz.why: The treatise says sixteen are real and the rest not. Master Cháng Bǎi: male and female faculties are provisional as phases depending on the body faculty; the life faculty is a dissociated formation, provisionally set on the time, measure, and phase of form and mind continuing, as determined by past karma. The last three are phases of nine faculties.

quiz.q: The English has "a phase of the body faculty" for 根分. How is this rendering, and which are the nine?
options: "phase" is poor and should be "part"; the nine are the six with male, female, and life, of which the three form a part
根分 should be "root"; the nine are faith and the rest with four feelings
"phase" conveys 分位 well; the nine are mind, faith and the rest, pleasure, joy, and equanimity, on which the three rest
根分 should be "share"; the nine are the seven physical with mind and life
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: the three uncontaminated faculties arise from nine phenomena: the mind, and eight mental factors, the five wholesome faculties with joy, pleasure, and equanimity; since accomplishing the path is surely joyful, happy, or tranquil, those three feelings belong. "Phase" brings out the sense of a position rather than a component part.

quiz.q: Which faculties are neutral, and why can sorrow not be neutral?
options: all that are ripened results are neutral: the five, male, female, and life; sorrow is only wholesome or unwholesome, never neutral
sorrow is neutral, being a feeling without good or evil; ripened results are all good, so not neutral
only equanimity is neutral
all faculties are neutral
quiz.why: The treatise says eight are neutral, with five partially. Master Cháng Bǎi: all ripened results are neutral: the five faculties, the male and female faculties, and the life faculty; among the five feelings sorrow is excepted, for sorrow is only wholesome or unwholesome and is never neutral.

quiz.q: How do "possessing ripening" and "being ripening" differ?
options: possessing means able to bring a future result; being means it is itself a result
possessing means it is a result; being means it brings one, the latter being more excellent
they are the same
possessing concerns form; being concerns mind
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: possessing ripening means being able to bring about a ripened result in the future; being ripening means being such a result. If a phenomenon is wholesome or unwholesome and moves mind to make karma that brings a future result, it possesses ripening. The treatise's counts differ accordingly.

quiz.q: Why are the final three a supporting companion to ripening?
options: because uncontaminated faculties themselves bring ripening, noble ones' karma being the same as ordinary karma
because they obstruct ripening
because they are unrelated to ripening
they help a practitioner gain desirable ripened results, making life ever brighter and more excellent
quiz.why: The treatise says the final three assist desirable ripening, making it ever brighter and securing rebirth among humans or gods. Master Cháng Bǎi: they help a practitioner gain desirable ripened results, making life brighter and more excellent. They do not themselves ripen, being uncontaminated; they act as companion.

quiz.q: Why are twelve faculties not ripening?
options: because all twelve are outer things, not belonging to beings, unrelated to karma
pain, pleasure, sorrow, and joy arise from present conditions, and the three need practice, so they are not ripening
because all twelve belong only to noble ones
because all twelve are already severed
quiz.why: The treatise says twelve are not ripening, with nine partly so. Master Cháng Bǎi: pain, pleasure, sorrow, and joy arise from present conditions and so are not counted as ripening; the three uncontaminated faculties require practice; hence these twelve are not ripening. The next question, however, says all have a seed of ripening.

quiz.q: How many faculties are confined to the desire realm, the form realm, and none?
options: desire fifteen and four partly; form four partly; none nine and three partly, the desire realm being widest
all three have twenty-two
desire eight; form eight; formless six
desire four and fifteen partly; form fifteen partly; none three and nine partly
quiz.why: The treatise gives four and fifteen partly, fifteen partly, eight partly, and three and nine partly. Master Cháng Bǎi: desire-realm beings have male and female and mostly sorrow and pain, and so these four belong only to the desire realm; the nine faculties, in part, are unbound when joined with the uncontaminated path.
